entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Linnéa Petra Sofie Claeson is a human rights activist and law student, known for her feminism and trademark multi-coloured hair, which has earned her the nickname "rainbow warrior". She is also a former Swedish professional handball player, active from 2013 to 2017, who played for Ringkøbing Håndbold.
